question: In a certain code language, “KTG” is written as “38” and “MAY” is written as “39”. How will “DBC” be written in that language?
solution:
The positions of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

__LOGIC__: Sum of Positional Values of Letters = Code.

The pattern for this is as follows;

In KTG →

Positional Letters and positional Values are:

K = 11 

T = 20

G = 7

KTG = (11 + 20 + 7) = 38

And;

In MAY →

Positional Letters and positional Values are:

M = 13

A = 1

Y = 25

MAY = (13 + 1 + 25) = 39

Similarly;

In DBC →

Positional Letters and positional Values are:

D = 4

B = 2

C = 3

DBC = (4 + 2 + 3) = 9

Hence, the correct answer is "9".
